main.description: Validate that a sender has completed tip payment(s). Looks up by tipUri (a specific tip record), recordUri (sums all tips for that record), or subject (recipient DID). These are mutually exclusive and resolved in that order.

tipUri.description: AT-URI of a specific tip record. Takes precedence over recordUri and subject.

recordUri.description: AT-URI of the record being tipped. Takes precedence over subject.

subject.description: DID of the tip recipient. Ignored if tipUri or recordUri is provided.

amount.description: Expected tip amount in cents. If omitted, only checks that a tip exists.

valid.description: Whether the sender has completed and verified tip(s)

amount.description: Sum of all verified completed tip amounts in cents
